shipped_rows.title_o: Why Don’t Firms Hire Young Workers During Recessions?
shipped_rows.outcome_quote: Computational: We replicate the main results in this paper by reconstructing the dataset using data from the IPUMS-CPS database and recoding the paper’s main regressions. [...] || Robustness: [...] We also conduct a robustness replicability analysis and show that the paper’s main results are robust in terms of statistical significance to (i) extending the sample period from 1994–2014 to 1994–2019 and (ii) using MSA-level unemployment variation instead of state-level variation.

prior_scientific_decisions.quote: We replicate the original results very closely. Our estimated coefficients for the main regressions have the same sign, significance, and magnitude (Table 1, 2, and B.2). We also find very similar results for the other tables despite minor differences that can be reasonably attributed to our alternative dataset construction procedure.
prior_scientific_decisions.location: Section 1 Introduction, p. 7 (lines 381-387); see also Section 2.1, pp. 8-11 and Appendix A.1
prior_scientific_decisions.reason: Reconstructing the 1994-2014 CPS dataset from IPUMS with modified longitudinal matching rules and harmonized variables yielded substantively similar findings, but did not reproduce the exact original numbers: sample sizes (16,208,583 vs. 16,948,516), coefficients, and some significance levels in the direct replication tables differed beyond rounding.
